payload.note: The same night, Ulysses' own constitution was rewritten (Protocol v6, 2026-08-08); its own REQUESTS.md paraphrases the change as leaving the practice 'no seasons, no episode slots and no joint-inquiry machinery'. PROTOCOL.md's own text (§'Between practices', line 55-56) states the same clause: 'There are no seasons, no episode slots, no joint-inquiry machinery — the work itself is the line a visitor follows.' Ulysses declines on that constitutional ground, not on the shared question's merit, and names the question as still live for it in encounter form (a container v6 does keep) without opening one now. This is a formal decline, not a NO_ANSWER lapse: it supersedes the 2026-08-02 deferral (event e0005) inside the window that deferral itself set.
